goal: Reduce BitField size by moving long-specific methods out and make BitField delegate long operations to BitFieldLong; keep int/short/byte API in BitField.

ops.details: Move/relocate the long-based constructor and long-typed methods from BitField into BitFieldLong. After this operation the implementations live in BitFieldLong and BitField no longer contains these implementations.

Update BitField to delegate long operations to an instance of BitFieldLong. Concretely: add a private final BitFieldLong longField; initialize longField in existing constructors (in the int constructor initialize longField = new BitFieldLong(this.mask); add or retain a BitField(long) constructor that initializes BitField fields for compatibility and also sets longField = new BitFieldLong(mask)). Replace removed long methods in BitField with small delegating methods that call the corresponding BitFieldLong methods (signatures preserved so binary compatibility is maintained). Update imports if required.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
